name: smwmusic-devoid-spirits-ii-trick-s-auction
title: Devoid Spirits II - Trick's Auction
description:
The song that plays while you interact with Trick's Auction, where you can trade in candies for useful goods and lifes with a bit of luck, and even unlock exclusive paths in Devoid Spirits II with enough competition.

Released in C3 Winter 2022.
